1.body:
Ameet,

I saw Lollypop’s Mumbai studio is growing its UX team, and I wanted to share how my background in both agency design and product thinking applies to your projects.

In my B2B case study, Bounceless, I designed a cleaner verification experience for teams that depend on accurate email lists, translating usability testing findings directly into user flows. Earlier, during my time as a UI/UX designer at AT Creation, I conducted usability testing and worked alongside developers on design handoff. At Ascent Business Solutions, I also built reusable design systems that cut turnaround times for over one hundred digital and print assets.

You can view the full case study on my portfolio at https://ananya-portfolio-nu.vercel.app/.

Would you be open to taking a look at that case study, or a 15-minute call to discuss the Mumbai UX role?

Ananya Saini
+91-8605846929
https://ananya-portfolio-nu.vercel.app/

2.body:
Hi Anuja,

I saw your post for the Junior UI/UX Designer contract role in Aundh, and the focus on core UI/UX principles and Figma stood out to me.

I bring hands-on experience in UI/UX design from my time at AT Creation, where I conducted usability testing and translated user findings into cleaner flows and better interface usability. My background in computer science also helps me collaborate smoothly with developers during handoff.

My Bounceless case study shows my work creating a streamlined verification experience for users navigating complex B2B workflows, and you can view it here: https://ananya-portfolio-nu.vercel.app/

Could we set up a brief chat this week, and please note that I am currently based in Nagpur and ready to relocate for this onsite role in Pune?

Ananya
